look.brief: Two people planning a short trip, swiping on a phone in a spare minute. Each idea is a paper luggage tag with a three-letter code, so the deck feels like packing, not like a form; no sketches, the words and the code carry it.
look.card: TAG · WEEKEND AWAY

atoms.title: Nothing planned at all
atoms.line: Wake up, then decide. The only booking is the bed.

atoms.title: One big thing a day
atoms.line: A morning for the main event, the rest is wandering.

atoms.title: Packed from dawn to late
atoms.line: A list, a route and a reason to be up at six.

atoms.title: Late breakfasts, early nights
atoms.line: Sleep is part of the trip, not time off from it.

atoms.title: Decide at the station
atoms.line: Pick the next train from the board, not from a plan.

atoms.title: A cabin with no signal
atoms.line: Woodstove, one lamp, and nobody can reach you.

atoms.title: A proper old hotel
atoms.line: Heavy keys, a doorman and a bar with a pianist.

atoms.title: Someone's spare room
atoms.line: A host who tells you where they actually eat.

atoms.title: A tent by water
atoms.line: Cold mornings, hot tea and the sound of a river.

atoms.title: High up, city lights below
atoms.line: A small room on a high floor with a huge window.

atoms.title: Eat only from the market
atoms.line: Bread, cheese, fruit and a knife. Lunch on a wall.

atoms.title: One meal worth the trip
atoms.line: A booking made weeks ago, and a dress code.

atoms.title: Street food crawl
atoms.line: Ten small things from ten stalls, standing up.

atoms.title: Cook it ourselves
atoms.line: Buy local things, figure out the stove, eat late.

atoms.title: A bakery every morning
atoms.line: The trip is planned around who opens first.

atoms.title: A long walk with a view
atoms.line: Six hours on a trail, lunch at the top.

atoms.title: Museums and old streets
atoms.line: Rainy-day culture, even if it is sunny.

atoms.title: Swim somewhere cold
atoms.line: A lake, the sea, a river. In, out, shouting.

atoms.title: Little shops and flea markets
atoms.line: Come home with one thing nobody else has.

atoms.title: Steam, soak and sleep
atoms.line: Baths, saunas and a robe for most of the day.

atoms.title: A tiny bar with no sign
atoms.line: Twelve seats, a bartender who remembers you.

atoms.title: Live music somewhere sweaty
atoms.line: A band nobody has heard of, too loud, perfect.

atoms.title: Stars and a fire
atoms.line: Far from any town, a blanket and a long sky.

atoms.title: In bed by ten with a book
atoms.line: The night is the quiet part, on purpose.

atoms.title: Walking the city at night
atoms.line: Lit windows, empty squares and a late snack.

atoms.title: Just the two of us
atoms.line: No group chat, no plans with anyone else.

atoms.title: The whole gang
atoms.line: A big table, a long dinner and too many photos.

atoms.title: Completely alone
atoms.line: Your pace, your choices, nobody to check with.

atoms.title: With family
atoms.line: Grandparents, kids, everyone, a house big enough.

atoms.title: Meet locals
atoms.line: A tour by someone who lives there, or a class.

atoms.title: A slow train
atoms.line: Window seat, a book and five hours of fields.

atoms.title: A road trip
atoms.line: Stops wherever looks good, music up.

atoms.title: A short flight away
atoms.line: Somewhere that feels far, two hours from home.

atoms.title: By bike
atoms.line: Panniers, maps, and legs that hurt on day two.

atoms.title: Under an hour from home
atoms.line: Close enough to leave after work on Friday.

atoms.title: An alpine village
atoms.line: Wooden balconies, cowbells and a cable car.

atoms.title: A fishing town off-season
atoms.line: Grey sea, closed ice cream stands, great fish.

atoms.title: A big city break
atoms.line: Galleries, rooftops and a different district each day.

atoms.title: A desert under stars
atoms.line: Dunes at sunset, cold nights and a silent morning.

atoms.title: A small island
atoms.line: One road, one shop, a ferry twice a day.
